title: Scene calendar event (DRAFT v1)
description: Normalised view of one Google Calendar event on the private scene calendar. Only the server reads this; the client only ever receives the resolved sceneId.

summary.description: Exactly one scene ID, nothing else. <base>.<spot>.<activity>.<time>.<weather>.v<n>. <time> and <weather> may be '*' to mean 'resolve live' (Chicago slot / real weather).

start.description: RFC 3339 with offset (Google 'dateTime'). All-day events are ignored.

location.description: Optional travel override for weather (and time zone of the sky, see open question). Either 'lat,lon' or a place name geocoded server-side. Empty = Dallas.

ticket.description: Team ticket id (Atlas). Never sent to the client.
